Fixed_Header.File_Description: EAGLET-2 RGB3 colour correction: LUT towards Sentinel-2 L1C and Enrico's class model; Method selects which one the processor applies
Fixed_Header.Notes: One file for the whole constellation. Input: DN x GAIN + OFFSET from the product XML (correct from 2026-09-24). LUT and HYBRID keep the brightness as delivered; CLASS_MODEL brings it close to Sentinel-2

Colour_Correction.Reference: Sentinel-2 L1C top-of-atmosphere reflectance, bands B04 B03 B02
Colour_Correction.Input: in_k = DN_k * GAIN_k + OFFSET_k, with GAIN and OFFSET from the product's own XML (Rescaling_Factors): the brightness stays as delivered
Colour_Correction.Model: b_k = in_k / balance_k; out_k = b_k * q_k(x, y, v); x = ln(b_1 / b_2), y = ln(b_3 / b_2), v = vegetation around; linear interpolation between nodes, clamped at the edges; pixels with no data or any band <= 0 are left unchanged

Vegetation_Around.method: balanced bands averaged into 10 m cells; each cell scores veg_share at its (x, y); mean over the window, cells with no data left out

Colour_Correction.Training_Data: Baseline A01: 6 EAGLET-2 products (near-infrared shares, colour balance, footprints) and 59 Sentinel-2 sources in all

Class_Model.training: one scene: Cape Town, Sentinel-2 S2B 2026-09-26, tile 34HBH
Class_Model.description: water / vegetation / built-up picked from the RGB triplet by Gaussian mixtures (8 per class), one transform per class; negatives set to 0
